nativeGeneration: 10,000 freshly inferred 256-dimensional vectors in their own isolated root, weights copied by COW. Generation was contended and paused for 1,070,018 ms; indexing throughput is not a quiet reference.
desktopMeasurement: Separate quiet Electron/production SQLite run, 21 distinct queries per size (one cold, twenty hot), prefix/special tokens included. Semantic candidates asserted. No remote embeddings.
limitation: 50,000-vector scan reuses real generated vectors; it is a capacity scan, not a 50,000-document quality test. Per-process peaks are upper bounds, not simultaneous resident totals. No Windows/Linux/macOS Intel extrapolation.
